title: Advanced Node (≤7nm) Wafer Capacity by Country, 2025
title_pt: Onde os Chips de Ponta São Fabricados (capacidade ≤7nm, 2025)

context.trend_pt: Taiwan tinha 71% da capacidade de ponta em 2021; projeção é cair para 58% em 2030. EUA passa de ~0% para 22% em 2030 com ramp da Arizona da TSMC e Intel 18A.
context.trend: Taiwan held 71% of advanced-node capacity in 2021; projected to fall to 58% by 2030. USA goes from ~0% to 22% by 2030 as TSMC Arizona and Intel 18A ramp.

sources.label: TrendForce: Foundry Capacity Market Share, May 2024
Electronics Weekly: US 22% of advanced node by 2030

notes: Country-level 2025 shares are estimates triangulated from foundry-by-foundry capacity (TSMC ~600-700k wpm in Taiwan; Samsung ~110k wpm in Korea; SMIC ~60k wpm in China at 7nm DUV; TSMC Arizona + Intel 18A ~50k wpm in US; Rapidus 2nm in Japan still ramping). Methodology (whether to include leading-edge memory, Samsung Texas, etc.) shifts numbers by ±2pp.
